findings.title: Stage Antigravity assets from the caller’s Git index
findings.body: If `hooks.json` is removed from the index but left on disk, `cp` copies it and the synthetic `git add .` tracks it again. The smoke can pass while the real package fails verification with `missing runtime closure`. Conversely, an untracked backup symlink under `.antigravity-plugin` makes the smoke reject a candidate the real build accepts.

findings.title: Check source link counts before copying tracked assets
findings.body: A checkout with a hard-linked `hooks.json` fails the real build because `build-assets.mjs` requires `st.nlink === 1`. The copy creates a fresh inode, so the synthetic build passes that check. Selecting tracked paths alone would still mask this failure on hard-linked local clones.

findings.title: Fail closed when Claude environment enumeration fails
findings.body: With `compgen` disabled or absent from the Bash build, `set -Eeuo pipefail` still lets the script continue. The `ERR` trap exits the command substitution, but the `for` loop receives an empty list and succeeds. This leaves `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` and `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR` pointing at the caller’s state when plugin installation starts.

findings.title: Isolate OpenCode’s XDG configuration directory
findings.body: With `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` pointing at the caller’s normal config directory, the package installs its plugin under the temporary `$HOME/.config/opencode`, while `opencode debug config` reads the caller’s directory. A correct package fails when the caller lacks the plugin. An existing caller installation can also satisfy the smoke’s suffix check using the wrong plugin.

findings.title: Keep Claude debug output inside the temporary directory
findings.body: A caller running with `DEBUG=1` and `CLAUDE_CODE_DEBUG_LOGS_DIR` set to their normal log directory retains both settings. Claude’s plugin commands write smoke diagnostics there, and the exit trap only removes `$tmp`. The three-directory isolation check recorded in validation misses these writes.

findings.title: Bind full-suite verification to the final smoke candidate
findings.body: The disposition marks the finding fixed using results for `8db4ef5`, which still leaked the caller’s plugin cache. The environment loop first appears in `22030fb`. The record reports a focused smoke pass after that change, but its full-suite table ends at the earlier commit and explicitly skips the code-review lanes there. It therefore supplies no `make test` result for the reviewed candidate.
